svg.title: How Oversay fits together
svg.desc: A map of Oversay. In the middle are the parts we wrote: the Oversay skill, the desktop app for Mac and Windows, the oversay.app site, the Oversay API and the iPhone app. Around them are the services they connect to: AI assistants and Hugging Face on the left; AWS Cognito with Google and Apple sign-in above; Neon Postgres on the right; GitHub, Cloudflare, App Store Connect and Homebrew below.
